textRuns.value: This table shows the average length of tenancy for all tenancies that started prior to the end of the chosen Financial Year. It is important to note that this page is not affected by the Financial Year slicer that dictates the data throughout the rest of the report. In order to correctly set the filter for this page, set the Tenancy Start Date filter to on or before the last day of the financial year you are interested in. For example for FY 2022 that date would be 30/06/2022. Each tenancy is split into the financial years over which it spans, hence the needs for the "Tenancy Start Date in FY" and "Tenancy End Date in FY" columns. These help to determine the number of days the tenancy was active in each FY. The "Actual" columns show the true beginning and end date of the tenancy.
If you have a slicer on Gender or Ethnicity, please be aware that this only applies to the
tenant and in some cases may not be useful.
